subject: FY2024 Water And Sewer Rate Increase
overview: The Commission approved a 7% rate increase for fiscal year 2024, utilizing a $500,000 budget transfer to mitigate the impact on residents. The meeting also addressed a significant hardship abatement request for a residential pipe burst and the necessity of a 10-year capital plan for infrastructure replacement.

items.title: Staffing and Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the previous meeting and discussed the upcoming retirement of the commission secretary.

items.title: Hardship Abatement Request - 89 Sheppard Road
items.summary: The commission reviewed a request for relief following a major pipe burst but deferred a decision pending the submission of unemployment documentation from the residents.

items.title: FY2024 Water and Sewer Rates
items.summary: Approved a 7% rate increase for the upcoming fiscal year, incorporating a $500,000 city budget transfer and a reduced assessment from the MWRA.

items.title: Infrastructure Replacement Planning
items.summary: Members and staff discussed the long-term financial challenge of replacing 123 miles of aging water and sewer mains, estimated at $1.5 million per mile.

items.title: Meter Disputes and Testing
items.summary: Reviewed the results of meter testing for disputed bills, including a case on High Street where testing validated the meter's accuracy.
